title: Etale origin and reflection of perfect local models
statement: Let X be any scheme, B a finite commutative ring in the scheme universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet and psi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism. Fix an R-derived complex K, an X-etale chart V and a<=b. Suppose a covering etale sieve on V supplies actual ringed-slice isomorphisms of K with constant finite-projective complexes supported in [a,b], using [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data, def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. Then there exists an etale derived ULift(B)-module sheaf L on V.left such that, for every W->V and every small algebraic derived B-complex F, a constant-model isomorphism for L pulled back to W.left exists if and only if the corresponding actual ringed-slice constant-model isomorphism for K exists. This does not assert perfectness or choose a geometric fibre.

proof.text: Choose one model-cover member through each point of V.left. Pullback composition gives coherence of the fixed-coordinate chart functors. The derived slice-coordinate equivalence converts each actual constant model to a constant model of the fixed-coordinate restriction J on V.left.

Exact cohomology comparison identifies local cohomology with constants of the lifted homology of the supplied perfect complex. Finite B is Noetherian, so this homology is finite. Coverwise detection proves vanishing outside [a,b]. Finite constant heart models give etale origins of all cohomology sheaves, and bounded truncation devissage produces a bounded-below etale L marked by comparisonUpperStar(L)~=J.

Comparison/pullback and comparison/constant natural isomorphisms identify constant models on each chart. The forward direction maps the supplied isomorphism and uses the coordinate equivalence. For the reverse direction, comparison reflects bounds; even an arbitrary F has bounded constant realization if it is isomorphic to the bounded restriction of J. The comparison adjunction units are invertible on both bounded-below objects, and applying the derived right adjoint lifts the isomorphism.

theorem finitePerfectChart_etale_origin
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (ψ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hψ : IsIso ψ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)))
    (V : X.Etale) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hmodel : ∃ T : Sieve V, T ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology V ∧
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V), T g →
        ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ,
          P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
          (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective B (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite B (P.X i)) ∧
          Nonempty
            (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
                ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
                ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
              ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
                ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
                ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X ψ).obj
                  ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X B).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))))) :
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory
        (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))),
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B)),
        Nonempty
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))
              g.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj L ≅
            (constantSheaf W.left.smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                ((finitePerfectAdicAlgebraLift B).obj F)) ↔
        Nonempty
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
            ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X ψ).obj
                ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X B).obj F)))
